_note: INA219 high-side current/power monitor module (TI). I2C interface, default address 0x40 (A0/A1 straps on module PCB). 6-pin breakout: VCC, GND, SDA, SCL on bottom; VIN+ and VIN- (sense resistor terminals, series with load) on top. Measures bus voltage (0-26V), shunt voltage, current and power. 12-bit ADC. Onboard 0.1 ohm shunt resistor on most modules.
